h: 这是我使用的基本 Z-Image Turbo 工作流程。它适用于任何 Diffusion_Model 版本的 Z-Image Turbo，模型建议为 VAE 和文本编码器。为了帮助您入门，我已将所需的节点保持在最低限度。

o.en: This is a basic Z-Image Turbo workflow that I use. It works for any Diffusion_Model version of Z-Image Turbo, with the model suggested VAE and Text Encoder. I've kept the required nodes to a minimum to get you started.
